title: EnableDetection - Debug
content:
Member of: Debug Script Enables/disables AI detection in the game. Syntax: Function EnableDetection(bool abEnable = true) native global debugOnly Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables AI detection, if false, disables it. Default: True Return Value: None Examples: ; Enables AI detection Debug.EnableDetection()
; Disables AI detection Debug.EnableDetection(false) See Also: - Debug Script - EnableAI - Debug
